notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check MHS/drivers/robots/robotcontrolstack__robot-control-stack --backend fake; evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level. Model-authored and unreviewed; no hardware was attached and the sim backend was not run. DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: none, the card's family-config GymnasiumDriver shape fits the registered gymnasium environment. The driver is simulated R0 as the card requires; it has no hardware backend and no e-stop path to a machine. Implemented one device class, rcs/fr3, using the first confirmed entry symbol rcs.envs.base:SimEnv; the other registered environments rcs/duo, rcs/droid, rcs/ur5e, rcs/xarm7, rcs/so101 and rcs/yam (configs.py:629-634) are named in facts.md but not exposed, per the one-device rule. The fake is a pure Python kinematic stand-in because the gate never imports or installs the clone, MuJoCo or the compiled rcs._core; gymnasium.make('rcs/fr3') (the sim backend) was not run. NOT COVERED: the camera observations of the registered environment, 1280x720 frames at 30 Hz for bird_eye and wrist (configs.py:105-120); the observation contract carries robot state only. The action limits are derived by the Gymnasium bridge from the fake action space; the fake narrows the three quaternion vector elements from the upstream's -inf/inf to [-1,1] so every bound can be probed, and this is in the fidelity gaps. The fidelity is F0 with timestep_ms 0 because the clone states a 1 Hz control loop but no fixed physics timestep. Warnings: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the bridge stores the seed for the next reset and makes no native call); G7.MAYBE_ABSENT for action_space and observation_space (they come from the external gym.Env base of BaseEnv, not from SimEnv's own AST); G8.NO_UNIT x5 for the bridge-derived ticks, seed twice, action.right.tquat[*] and action.right.gripper[*] inputs. No G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warnings. The gate digest is the stable digest line the last check printed; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run.
